text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, Ines Fujin is<n>trembling with sheer
anticipation. I can<n>tell she's even more excited now
than she was before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The two of us have chased her<n>dream this far, and I
bet at the Japan<n>Cup she's going to show me
where<n>it goes next!
